decisions.reason: As a flagship product line that is close to the firm’s core practice software and supported by the firm’s own R&D, it fits its existing knowledge base well and is therefore likely to be improved rather than withdrawn.

The education institute extends the firm’s established training and practitioner-facing capabilities, so despite being somewhat less central than software it still builds on related knowledge and is likely to be retained.

The remote support tool complements the firm’s software support and integration capabilities, and with a growing firm in a growing industry it is more likely to be absorbed into the service offering than taken off the market.
